nodes.text: Is there a covering system such that no two of the moduli divide each other?

#586 : [ErGr80] [Er96b] [Er97] [Er97c] [Er97e] number theory | covering systems Asked by Schinzel, motivated by a question of Erdős and Selfridge (see [7] ). The answer is no, as proved by Balister, Bollobás, Morris, Sahasrabudhe, and Tiba [BBMST22] .
